Name: Save 10 Seconds
Author: quan2808
Description:
[size=5][b]Save 10 Seconds[/b][/size]

Every time you open Stardew Valley, you sit through the same intro before you can do anything. This mod skips it for you, and takes you straight to where you actually want to go.

You pick what to skip by ticking a few simple boxes. That's it!

[size=4][b]What you can skip[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]The intro[/b]: go straight to the title menu (on by default)[/*]
[*][b]To your saves[/b]: skip the title menu too and land right on the Load screen[/*]
[*][b]To Join co-op[/b]: open the co-op screen on the Join tab, ready to hop into a friend's farm[/*]
[*][b]To Host co-op[/b]: open the co-op screen on the Host tab, ready to start your own game[/*]
[/list]
It works every time the game starts, and every time you go back to the title screen.

[size=4][b]Out of the box[/b][/size]
With no setup at all, the mod simply skips the intro and shows you the title menu. If that's all you want, you're done. Install it and enjoy the shorter wait.

[size=4][b]How to change what's skipped[/b][/size]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], then open this mod's settings and tick the boxes you want. No files to edit.

[b]Good to know:[/b]
[list]
[*]Only one destination is used at a time. If you tick more than one, the game picks in this order: Host co-op, then Join co-op, then Load screen.[/*]
[*]If you pick a destination, the intro is skipped automatically.[/*]
[*]On Android, the co-op options aren't available.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installing[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI, and enjoy the shorter wait![/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Please don't use this together with the original Skip Intro. They do the same thing, so keep just one.[/*]
[*]It only changes how the menus open. It doesn't touch your save files, and you can remove it any time.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
This mod is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/533]Skip Intro[/url] by Pathoschild, used with permission under the MIT License. This version has a new settings screen with simple tick boxes, and a reorganized code base.

Manifest.Name: Save 10 Seconds
Manifest.Description: Skips the startup intro and jumps straight to the screen you choose (title menu, load menu or co-op). Based on Skip Intro by Pathoschild.
